directory.profile.title: {name}'s profile
directory.profile.description: See this member's details, how to reach them, and their role.
directory.profile.offline: Disconnected. This is the last profile we received. You can start a new conversation once the connection is back.
directory.profile.offlineMissing: Disconnected. We could not find this member's last profile.
directory.profile.emptyHeadline: This member is not on the roster.
directory.profile.emptyDetail: Reload the roster, then check the profile again.
directory.profile.dmSelf: You cannot open a direct message from your own profile.
directory.profile.dmInactive: You cannot open a direct message while this member is {status}.
directory.manage.heading: Manage
directory.manage.hint: Only people with the {owner} or {admin} role see this
directory.role.label: Role
directory.role.lockedOwnerPeer: People with the {owner} role cannot change each other's roles.
directory.role.lockedAdminCeiling: The {admin} role cannot change the role of someone who is {admin} or {owner}.
directory.role.confirmGrantAdmin: The {admin} role can change the role of {member} and {guest} people, suspend or remove them, and create password reset links for them. It can also create channels and add or remove people in channels.
directory.role.confirmRevokeAdmin: They will no longer be able to change the role of {member} and {guest} people, suspend or remove them, create password reset links, create channels, or add and remove people in channels.
directory.role.confirmOwnerWarning: {name} will have the same permissions as you. People with the {owner} role cannot change each other's roles or remove each other, so this cannot be undone.
